text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis. The presence of eosinophilic cells in the urine suggests an allergic interstitial nephritis triggered by the antibiotics, which mimics the symptoms of pyelonephritis; however, your negative bacterial culture confirms the infection was not the primary cause.
